selection_rule: Mean of three validation binary log losses improves by >0.001 over current serving and both matched no-weather ablations (logistic and CatBoost); no target worsens by more than 5% versus current serving.
notice: Experimental fixed 72h-lead JMA weather plus prior nonfinish/circuit conditions. Unsupported stages or missing weather retain existing predictions.
